result.instructions: Wikifier answers from a resolved import map, not text matches. Prefer it to grep for: get_dependents before you change a struct, trait, enum, signature or export (every importer, including Rust glob imports and JS/TS barrels and re-exports grep misses); get_cycles before you add an import between modules; why_file before you change a file you did not write; health or check_changes before you commit (modularity alerts: a file over the line or fan-in limit). In a git worktree, pass worktree_root (absolute path) to read tools so answers describe your tree, not main. Writers (record_change, mark_green) run on main only.
